message:
I see - `NewCodePage` allocates memory with `m3_Malloc` but doesn't initialize `page->info.lineIndex` or `page->info.next`. This means `NumFreeLines` reads uninitialized memory (`lineIndex` and `numLines`). This is the MSAN "UNKNOWN READ" issue.

Let me look at the `M3CodePageHeader` structure and understand what fields are uninitialized:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "M3CodePageHeader\|typedef struct.*CodePage\|info.lineIndex\|info.next\|info.numLines" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/wasm3/source/m3_code.h | head -30</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
